signal: DCI launched a partnership with Unifimoney to bring digital wealth management to its community-bank clients and is running its 2026 DCI Conference

email.body1:
Layne, saw DCI partner with Unifimoney to add digital wealth management for your community-bank clients.

New capabilities like that open conversations across your whole prospect base, usually more banks in-market than the national team can cover at once. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for DCI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Layne, quick follow-up for DCI.

A new fintech offering creates demand across community banks, but most teams can't tell how many of those prospects they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up late in the year.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings DCI's national team needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Layne, last bit of proof for DCI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how DCI's reply rate likely compares to peer core-banking providers. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Layne, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling national pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out new fintech partnerships is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a community-banking motion? I'll tailor it to DCI either way.
